summary: Plan TSA readiness, account coverage and cash controls through applied treasury exercises. Explore the course outline and enrol.
lede: Treasury function training helps public finance professionals assess cash visibility and prepare a practical Treasury Single Account (TSA) implementation plan. Through applied exercises, participants map account coverage, build cash forecasts and trace commitment-to-payment controls while identifying reconciliation gaps. The exercises produce a coverage map, forecast assumptions, a control matrix and a phased roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for public finance professionals who work directly with government cash, banking arrangements, payments or the controls that support a Treasury Single Account.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public finance, treasury operations, government payments or bank reconciliation will help you apply the exercises.
